jia: Heads-up — onboarding Odyssey-10B (hf: /models/odyssey/10b) hit a weird kv-cache / rotary mismatch in staging after ~1k tokens. Output goes from sensible -> repeated fragments.
kevin: Can you paste the conversion command you used? sounds like head ordering or rotary freq mismatch.
jia: Sure — ran: `python tools/convert_model.py --src hf --model odyssey-10b --format fused --quant int4 --out /staging/models/odyssey-10b-conv`
jia: quick log: `RuntimeWarning: kv_cache shape mismatch: expected (batch, heads, seq, head_dim) got (batch, heads, seq, head_dim) but different head ordering` — not super helpful.
marta: Odyssey uses head-interleave packing (every other head from two groups) and per-head rotary frequencies. Our naive head-order preservation will scramble per-head sin/cos.
samir: +1. I remember a similar hit on Hydra-7b — symptoms: coherent until kv-cache reuse kicks in, then echoing / token collapse.
kevin: Did you try running the small unit test we added for headmap verification? `tests/rotary_headmap_check.py` — it checks the dot products of rotated queries vs reference.
jia: Ran it, diff is large: `max_abs_diff = 0.27` (should be <1e-4).
marta: That confirms headmap reorder. Try `--reorder-heads odyssey_headmap.json` during conversion. Our mapping file should be in tools/headmaps/ (I think we generated one for Odyssey during model onboarding).
jia: I don't see an odyssey_headmap in tools/headmaps. I have `headmap_guess.py` which heuristically tries 2 interleavings but didn't converge.
samir: I can generate a precise map. I'll run an attention-probe to align saved weights to runtime ordering. Steps: 1) load raw checkpoint, 2) compute (QK^T) basis on a fixed random input, 3) compute Hungarian matching across heads. It takes ~30s per layer.
kevin: Also check rotary frequency scaling. Odyssey uses per-head freq multiplier (not the typical global scale). If headmap is wrong you see catastrophic failures; if freq scalars are wrong you see more subtle drift.
jia: Good call. I dumped rotary params — there is a `rotary_freqs` tensor with shape (heads,) which our converter currently treats as (head_groups, head_dim). Oops.
marta: That will do it. Two fixes needed: correct head ordering + ensure `rotary_freqs` is read as per-head scalars and broadcasted properly to head_dim.
samir: I'm running the Hungarian align now. Will push a headmap file and a small patch to `tools/convert_model.py` to accept `--headmap path` and `--rotary-scalar-mode per_head|per_group`.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: build/convert-tools#1245 (CI) — will run tests after samir's PR. :gear:
kevin: For quantization: int4 projection weight layout also depends on head ordering for fused QKV kernels. When we reorder heads post-quant, the int4 blocks may not map cleanly and you can get large fp32 recon errors. Prefer reorder on FP32 checkpoint then quantize.
jia: Noted — I had quantize-after-convert. I'll revert and re-run.
samir: Patch pushed to my branch: `samir/odyssey-headmap` with `tools/headmaps/odyssey_headmap.json` and `convert_model` flag support. It also contains a mini-eval harness run output: `perplexity (eval-set)`: 5.3 (reference) vs 17.8 (broken). After fix: 5.4 — within noise.
marta: Nice. Can we add the headmap generator into onboarding CI so future head-interleave models auto-generate and verify?
kevin: Yes — add a stage in `ci/onboard-models.yml` after download: run headmap-gen + rotary-check, fail fast if max_abs_diff > 1e-3.
jia: I'm re-running conversion (FP32 reorder -> quant). I'll post results in ~10m. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
kevin: If you hit anything, ping me and I'll grab a debug session.
samir: FYI I left a short README in `tools/headmaps/README.md` explaining the Hungarian heuristic + caveats for per-head rotary.
ops-bot: CI build/convert-tools#1245 completed — tests: 112/112 passed.
jia: Reconverted and redeployed to staging — outputs look good, long-context coherent past 8k tokens now. Perplexity 5.5 on eval set, generation sample looks sane. Closing triage. :white_check_mark:
